title: Relationship Relativity for a Reported Resident Listed Before Exclusion — Owner Auto Policy Filed Driver Rating Q&A
content:
**Rule.** Under the company's filed driver rating, a relationship relativity multiplies the listing share of a household resident listed on the Owner Auto Policy before exclusion. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent. The relationship is the one recorded on the resident's most recent entry on the term.

| Relationship recorded | Relativity |
|---|---|
| child, sibling, parent or other relative | 1.05 |
| unrelated household member | 1.2 |
| spouse, or any other relationship | 1 |
| no such entry on the term | 1 |

**Questions the rule answers.**
- *A resident recorded as a sibling: which relativity applies?* 1.05.
- *A roommate recorded as an unrelated household member?* 1.2.
- *A resident who has no entry on the term?* 1.
- *Hypothetically, a listing share of 200.00 before this relativity, for a resident recorded as unrelated?* The share becomes 240.00 before rounding.
